text: McArthurGlen Group, the operator of the McArthurGlen Troyes designer outlet, has been a joint venture between the Kaempfer Partners and Simon Property Group, Inc (NYSE: SPG) since 2013; the group was founded in 1993 by the Kaempfer Partners.
short: McArthurGlen is a Kaempfer Partners / Simon Property Group joint venture.
